propositions: Token usage (input/output/cache tokens + request count) from live LLM calls in weekly jobs is not retrievable; per-call usage is computed in PydanticAIRunner but dropped by both the eval and pytest paths

Two weekly GitHub Actions jobs (external-integration and prompt-eval) make billable LLM calls with zero visibility into cumulative token spend because usage data does not surface to job summaries or artifacts
A single process-level usage sink should be added at the shared _usage seam in PydanticAIRunner.run to capture usage for both jobs without per-test or per-eval plumbing

New usage_log module must provide record(usage, op) JSONL sink (opt-in via REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var, no-op when unset) and summarize(path) CLI to generate Markdown totals and per-op breakdown for GitHub job summaries
Both weekly workflows must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG to runner.temp/usage.jsonl, append summarize output to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY with if: always(), and upload raw JSONL as artifact
